metrics.label: Total population
metrics.desc: Resident + non-resident headcount per hex8. Calibrated to SingStat Jun-2024 (6.04M nationally).

metrics.label: Non-resident share
metrics.desc: Fraction of population that is non-resident (work-permit, dorm, FDW, students). High in industrial/CBD.

metrics.label: Dorm workers
metrics.desc: Migrant-worker dormitory population placed at real MOM dorm locations (439,198 nationally, DASL H2-2024).

metrics.label: Night lights 2024
metrics.desc: VIIRS night-light radiance 2024 — proxy for built/economic intensity.

metrics.label: Night-light growth
metrics.desc: % change in night lights 2022->2024. Positive = brightening (growth corridor).

metrics.label: Commercial activity
metrics.desc: NEW footfall-weighted economic-activity index: night lights + spend proxy + transit taps + place density + OD throughput. Distinct from supply-only commercial_intensity (corr 0.84).

metrics.label: Commercial intensity (supply)
metrics.desc: Supply/morphology composite: commercial place mix + commercial night-light + commercial land-use share.

metrics.label: OD throughput
metrics.desc: Total transit journeys originating + terminating in this hex (LTA DataMall OD, Apr-2026 weekday monthly). Bus+train, 100% mapped.

metrics.label: OD net flow (in-out)
metrics.desc: Inbound minus outbound journeys. Positive = net destination (job/retail magnet); negative = net origin (residential).

metrics.label: Day-night breathing
metrics.desc: EMERGENT: z(OD inflow) - z(resident pop). High = fills by day, empties at night (job center). Low = empties by day (bedroom community).

metrics.label: Latent retail demand
metrics.desc: EMERGENT: z(commercial activity) - z(commercial supply). High = high footfall but under-built retail (opportunity).

metrics.label: Transit access
metrics.desc: Composite transit accessibility (MRT/LRT/bus proximity + frequency).

metrics.label: Walkability
metrics.desc: Pedestrian-infrastructure + amenity walk-distance composite.

metrics.label: Vibrancy
metrics.desc: Places + magnets + reviews + transit + night lights.

metrics.label: Livability
metrics.desc: Walkability + green + amenities + transit (note: stale vs current parks layer).

metrics.label: Density pressure
metrics.desc: Population + buildings + low road space.

metrics.label: Persona affluence
metrics.desc: NVIDIA Nemotron persona affluence proxy (university + professional/manager + finance/infocomm). PA-resolution broadcast.

metrics.label: Persona median age
metrics.desc: Median age of adult personas in this planning area (NVIDIA Nemotron, PA-resolution).

metrics.label: % university-educated
metrics.desc: Share of personas with a university degree (PA-resolution).

metrics.label: HDB resale 4-room $/sqm
metrics.desc: Median 4-room HDB resale price per sqm (227k transactions, town-broadcast).

metrics.label: Place density
metrics.desc: Total mapped places (POIs) per hex8 (~0.74 km2) — overall point-of-interest density.

metrics.label: Place-mix diversity
metrics.desc: Category diversity (entropy) of the place mix. High = mixed-use; low = monofunctional.

metrics.label: Magnet anchors
metrics.desc: High-draw anchor places (malls, hubs, major attractions; 30+ review demand magnets).

metrics.label: Unique brands
metrics.desc: Distinct retail/F&B brands present — chain/commercial richness.

metrics.label: Avg place rating
metrics.desc: Mean rating of rated places — quality proxy.

metrics.label: Total reviews
metrics.desc: Sum of place review counts — popularity / footfall proxy.

metrics.label: F&B (restaurants)
metrics.desc: Restaurant place count (see hawker/cafe/fast-food in the detail panel).

metrics.label: Retail shops
metrics.desc: Shopping / retail place count.

metrics.label: Capture potential (all)
metrics.desc: S1 Huff model: demand (outlet-equivalents) a NEW outlet at the best spot in this hex would capture across 11 categories, net of existing competition. 1.0 = supports one average outlet.

metrics.label: Supermarket capture
metrics.desc: Competition-adjusted demand winnable by a new supermarket. Yunnan (the known FairPrice desert) ranks p96.

metrics.label: Cafe capture
metrics.desc: Competition-adjusted demand winnable by a new cafe. Saturated Orchard ranks p03 — the inversion is the point.

metrics.label: Capture per rent (ROI)
metrics.desc: cap_total / residential rent $psf — opportunity per occupancy-cost proxy. Gray where no rent observation within 2.5 km.

metrics.label: Unserved pop (supermarket)
metrics.desc: Residents reachable in a 10-min walk who have NO supermarket within 800 m of home. Most novel column in the atlas (max |r|=0.14 vs all prior features).

metrics.label: 10-min walk catchment
metrics.desc: Population within an 800 m NETWORK walk of the hex activity centre (node-field demand, k=4 multi-source). Severance-aware, unlike rings.

metrics.label: 15-min transit reach
metrics.desc: Population reachable door-to-door in 15 min by weekday-AM transit (GTFS graph + walk arms). Interchange towns peak ~250K.

metrics.label: Daytime population
metrics.desc: Commuter daytime headcount: residents - AM out + AM in (OD-based, 0.62 PT mode share).

metrics.label: Labor pool (45-min)
metrics.desc: Working-age population that can reach this hex within 45-min transit. CBD = 1.68M (59.6% of workforce); Tuas = p0.

metrics.label: Live businesses (robust)
metrics.desc: ACRA live entities, per-postal contribution capped at 100 (registered-agent buildings winsorized). 94% of 2.07M entities geocoded.

metrics.label: Business mortality (2018+)
metrics.desc: Share of 2018+ registered entities now deregistered — churn-risk signal. Gray where no entities.

metrics.label: Resi rent $psf/mo
metrics.desc: URA private rental medians (913 projects, last 4 quarters, IDW 2.5 km). Commercial rent not openly available — this is the spatial price surface.

metrics.label: MRT exit footfall
metrics.desc: Weekday taps at the nearest station exit (<=400 m), split per exit from per-station PV. Few-exit busy stations (Punggol, Novena) legitimately beat 13-exit Orchard.

metrics.label: Future MRT distance
metrics.desc: Distance to the nearest FUTURE rail station (MP2019 minus existing Mar-2026: 37 stations — full JRL + Keppel CCL6). Reversed: closer = brighter.

metrics.label: Dev capacity (FAR headroom)
metrics.desc: (allowed GPR - built FAR) x residential zoning share. Matilda 0.50 / Bidadari 0.34; built-out Toa Payoh Central = 0.
